You OWN only: callisto.toml, .github/workflows/callisto-release.yml (and ci.yml lines that name callisto if any), docs/releasing.md. Do not touch Rust, TS or other workflows. Run `just lint doc-check machete typos` (exit code) and add a changeset ONLY if the repo convention says release tooling changes need one (check .changeset and AGENTS.md; a CI/tooling change normally needs none). Final message max 120 words: branch, head SHA, trail number, body path, blockers. Cap 70 tool calls; never ask questions.

TASK: (1) Find the Callisto 0.22.x release: the repo is orin-dx/callisto (try `gh release list -R orin-dx/callisto`, `gh api repos/orin-dx/callisto/git/ref/tags/callisto@0.22.0` or the tag naming the 0.20.0 pin uses, and a local clone at ~/Projects/callisto if present; read its CHANGELOG / migration notes / docs for 0.21 and 0.22 changes, especially the simplified toml config: which keys moved, were renamed, became defaults or were removed). Pick the latest 0.22.x tag and its commit SHA (resolve annotated tags to the commit SHA that the existing pins use). (2) Rewrite callisto.toml to the 0.22 simplified form: keep EXACTLY the same behaviour (same packages, publish targets, release triggers, fixed groups, cascade, changesets dir, release artifacts, product package); remove what 0.22 makes default or unnecessary; keep the useful explanatory comments, trimmed. The plans must be equal except for documented changes. If 0.22 needs workflow changes (renamed inputs/outputs, attestation workflow filename rules: callisto checks build attestations against the exact workflow filename, do not rename the workflow), make them and say why. If the plan differs or the config cannot be proven equivalent, stop and report what you verified.

# Pinned to callisto 0.20.0 in .github/workflows/callisto-release.yml.
# Callisto checks build attestations against that exact workflow filename; do not rename it.

# `match` is a package name ("<ecosystem>/<name>"), never a directory path.
# Root package.json is `caliper-docgen-workspace` so bare `caliper-docgen` stays unambiguous.

[changesets]
dir = ".changeset"

[cascade]
mode = "out-of-range"
bump-severity = "patch"
peer-escalation = true
preserve-npm-ranges = true

# The CLI binaries ship as assets of the one GitHub Release for the product package.
# The npm `bin` of `npm/caliper-docgen` cannot be a product, so the product is the Cargo crate.
# `target` matches the build matrix in callisto-release.yml; `asset-name` is the exact file name.
[release]
product-package = "cargo/caliper-docgen"
forge-repository = "orin-dx/caliper"

[[release.artifact]]
package = "cargo/caliper-docgen"
target = "aarch64-apple-darwin"
asset-name = "caliper-docgen-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz"

[[release.artifact]]
package = "cargo/caliper-docgen"
target = "x86_64-apple-darwin"
asset-name = "caliper-docgen-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz"

[[release.artifact]]
package = "cargo/caliper-docgen"
target = "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"
asset-name = "caliper-docgen-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz"

[[release.artifact]]
package = "cargo/caliper-docgen"
target = "aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu"
asset-name = "caliper-docgen-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz"

[[package]]
match = "cargo/caliper-docgen-core"
publish-to = ["crates-io"]
release-trigger = "changeset"

[[package]]
match = "cargo/caliper-docgen-semantic"
publish-to = ["crates-io"]
release-trigger = "changeset"

# The CLI is the product: each version gets one GitHub Release, with the
# `## <version>` section of crates/cli/CHANGELOG.md as its notes.
[[package]]
match = "cargo/caliper-docgen"
publish-to = ["crates-io", "github-release"]
release-trigger = "changeset"

[[package]]
match = "npm/caliper-docgen"
publish-to = ["npm"]
release-trigger = "changeset"

# FFI shim: versioned with its npm wrapper, never published to crates.io.
[[package]]
match = "cargo/caliper-docgen-napi"
publish-to = []
release-trigger = "changeset"

[[package]]
match = "npm/caliper-docgen-napi"
publish-to = ["npm"]
release-trigger = "changeset"

[[package]]
match = "npm/caliper-docgen-vite-plugin"
publish-to = ["npm"]
release-trigger = "changeset"

[[package]]
match = "npm/caliper-docgen-storybook"
publish-to = ["npm"]
release-trigger = "changeset"

# The npm wrapper is meaningless without a matching binding build. The Vite plugin and the
# Storybook addon depend on the binding at an exact version (`workspace:*` publishes as an
# exact pin), so a binding release must republish them or their users never receive it.
[[fixed-group]]
name = "napi-and-binding"
members = [
  "cargo/caliper-docgen-napi",
  "npm/caliper-docgen-napi",
  "npm/caliper-docgen-vite-plugin",
  "npm/caliper-docgen-storybook",
]

# The npm wrapper redistributes this crate's binaries.
[[fixed-group]]
name = "cli-and-npm-wrapper"
members = ["cargo/caliper-docgen", "npm/caliper-docgen"]

- Grammar sweep: list every syntax/type form the code can receive and show each is handled or declined (exhaustive match, or a generated test over the grammar with the checker/TS API as oracle). Generate over the grammar, not over past findings.
- Mutation proof: remove each guard/dependency; a test must fail. Report which you tried (cargo mutants --in-diff works).

name: Release & Publish

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  # Finishes a release that stopped, and refreshes the release PR, without waiting for a push.
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 5 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_source_sha:
        description: 'Merged Callisto release-PR commit to recover; leave empty for the oldest unfinished release or the triggering commit.'
        required: false
        type: string

# Registry credentials exist only inside `execute`.
permissions: {}

# Per-commit group: a shared group would drop a queued release merge.
concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  # Keep in lockstep with .prototools.
  RUST_VERSION: "1.99.1"
  # `callisto release pending` reads the committed decision of each of the 10 newest release commits,
  # and fails with E166 on older ones whose decision no longer decodes. Count this release and newer.
  RELEASE_PENDING_FROM: 2daef9276b234fcc04d8994d91210eeccd88d7e8

jobs:
  release-candidate:
    name: Identify a merged Callisto release PR
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    timeout-minutes: 10
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      is_release_pr: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.is_release_pr }}
      release_source_sha: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@aebeedcdaa1dce8f0d9ad1836844ab6be68daf1f # callisto@0.20.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.20.0
          verification: require
      - id: candidate
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT: ${{ inputs.release_source_sha }}
          TRIGGERING_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          release_source_sha="$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT"
          selected_pending=false
          if [[ -z "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
            # Oldest unfinished release first: a failed release is finished before a newer one starts.
            pending_json=$(callisto --format json release pending --from "$RELEASE_PENDING_FROM")
            # A renamed or missing `pending` key would read as "nothing unfinished" and skip a stuck release.
            jq -e '(.pending | type) == "array"' <<<"$pending_json" > /dev/null \
              || { echo "::error::'release pending' output has no .pending array"; exit 1; }
            release_source_sha=$(jq -r '.pending[0].source // empty' <<<"$pending_json")
            if [[ -n "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
              selected_pending=true
            elif [[ "$EVENT_NAME" == push ]]; then
              release_source_sha="$TRIGGERING_SHA"
            else
              # A scheduled run with nothing unfinished only refreshes the release PR.
              echo 'is_release_pr=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          if [[ ! "$release_source_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters"
            exit 1
          fi
          resolved_sha=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.sha')
          if [[ "$resolved_sha" != "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha does not resolve to that exact commit"
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$release_source_sha" "$TRIGGERING_SHA"; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha is not on main's history"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Scheduling hint only; `callisto release plan` is the authority. A trusted release commit is
          # the merge of the managed PR and a GitHub-verified signed commit, never a direct push.
          prs=$(gh api --paginate "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}/pulls" | jq -s --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --arg sha "$release_source_sha" '[.[][] | select(.merged_at != null and .merge_commit_sha == $sha and .base.ref == "main" and .head.repo.full_name == $repo and (.head.ref == "callisto/version-packages" or (.head.ref | test("^callisto/version-packages--[0-9a-f]{40}$")))) | .number]')
          verified=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.commit.verification.verified')
          if [[ "$(jq 'length' <<< "$prs")" == 1 && "$verified" == true ]]; then
            {
              echo 'is_release_pr=true'
              echo "release_source_sha=$release_source_sha"
            } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [[ "$selected_pending" == true || -n "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT" || "$(jq 'length' <<< "$prs")" != 0 ]]; then
            echo "::error::release source is not one verified merged managed PR"
            exit 1
          else
            echo 'is_release_pr=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  version-pr:
    name: Create or update the Callisto release PR
    needs: [release-candidate, drain]
    # `drain` is skipped unless a release just executed. Refresh the PR when this is not a release run,
    # or when the release that just ran left nothing unfinished.
    if: >-
      always() && needs.release-candidate.result == 'success' &&
      ((needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr != 'true' &&
        needs.drain.result == 'skipped' && inputs.release_source_sha == '') ||
       (needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true' &&
        needs.drain.result == 'success' && needs.drain.outputs.has_pending == 'false'))
    timeout-minutes: 15
    concurrency:
      group: version-pr
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
    permissions:
      actions: write
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      # Pinned here, not inherited from the action's default.
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@aebeedcdaa1dce8f0d9ad1836844ab6be68daf1f # callisto@0.20.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.20.0
          verification: require
      - name: Compose, version, and open the release PR
        uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/callisto-action@aebeedcdaa1dce8f0d9ad1836844ab6be68daf1f # callisto@0.20.0
        with:
          setup_callisto: 'false'
          branch: main
          release_branch: callisto/version-packages
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      # A pull request opened or updated with `github.token` starts no `pull_request` run, so the release PR would get
      # no CI at all, the corpora budget gate included. `workflow_dispatch` is the event `github.token` may start. Once
      # per head commit: this workflow also runs daily and on every push to main.
      - name: Run CI on the release PR's head commit
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          pr=$(gh pr list --state open --base main --json headRefName,headRefOid,headRepositoryOwner \
            --jq '[.[] | select((.headRefName | startswith("callisto/version-packages")) and .headRepositoryOwner.login == "'"${GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER}"'")] | first // empty')
          [ -n "$pr" ] || exit 0
          ref=$(jq -r .headRefName <<<"$pr")
          sha=$(jq -r .headRefOid <<<"$pr")
          ran=$(gh run list --workflow ci.yml --event workflow_dispatch --commit "$sha" --json databaseId --jq length)
          [ "$ran" = 0 ] || exit 0
          gh workflow run ci.yml --ref "$ref"

  plan:
    name: Derive release intent from the merged release commit
    needs: release-candidate
    if: needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 20
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      has_artifacts: ${{ steps.slots.outputs.has_artifacts }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # A detached checkout of the release commit: a branch checkout stops callisto with E170.
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@aebeedcdaa1dce8f0d9ad1836844ab6be68daf1f # callisto@0.20.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.20.0
          verification: require
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      # The orchestration revision is this run's own SHA: the build job's attestations are stamped with it.
      - name: Derive and hash intent
        env:
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          handoff_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          mkdir -p "$handoff_dir"
          callisto release plan \
            --source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" \
            --orchestration-revision "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --artifact-repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --from-release-commit "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" \
            --decision "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source/.callisto/release-decision.json" \
            --out "$handoff_dir/release-intent.json"
          # Relative name: the consumers verify from another job's RUNNER_TEMP.
          (cd "$handoff_dir" && shasum -a 256 release-intent.json > release-intent.json.sha256)
      # Slots exist only when the product package is in this release.
      - name: Read declared artifact slot count
        id: slots
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Own statement: set -e cannot see a substitution failing inside an echo argument.
          intent="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent/release-intent.json"
          # A renamed or missing key would read as "no slots" and publish a release without binaries.
          jq -e 'has("artifactSlots") and (.artifactSlots | type) == "array"' "$intent" > /dev/null \
            || { echo "::error::release intent has no .artifactSlots array"; exit 1; }
          has_artifacts=$(jq '.artifactSlots | length > 0' "$intent")
          case "$has_artifacts" in
            true|false) ;;
            *) echo "::error::artifact slot probe returned '$has_artifacts'"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          echo "has_artifacts=$has_artifacts" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
          if-no-files-found: error
          # Long enough to re-run `execute` after a multi-day diagnosis.
          retention-days: 7

  build:
    name: Build ${{ matrix.platform }}
    needs: [release-candidate, plan]
    timeout-minutes: 45
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.host }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      # Build provenance for the GitHub Release assets.
      attestations: write
      id-token: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
      matrix:
        # `target` and `asset` must match `[[release.artifact]]` in callisto.toml.
        include:
          - { host: macos-latest, target: aarch64-apple-darwin, platform: darwin-arm64, bin: caliper-docgen, asset: caliper-docgen-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz }
          - { host: macos-latest, target: x86_64-apple-darwin, platform: darwin-x64, bin: caliper-docgen, asset: caliper-docgen-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz }
          - { host: ubuntu-latest, target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, platform: linux-x64-gnu, bin: caliper-docgen, asset: caliper-docgen-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz, zig: true, glibc: '2.28' }
          - { host: ubuntu-latest, target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, platform: linux-arm64-gnu, bin: caliper-docgen, asset: caliper-docgen-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz, zig: true, glibc: '2.28' }
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      # No caches in release builds.
      - uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095 # v0.6.4
        with:
          auto-install: true
          cache: false
      - run: |
          rustup toolchain install "$RUST_VERSION" --profile minimal --target "$TARGET" --no-self-update
          rustup default "$RUST_VERSION"
        env:
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
      - if: matrix.zig
        uses: mlugg/setup-zig@d1434d08867e3ee9daa34448df10607b98908d29 # v2.2.1
        with:
          version: 0.14.1
          use-cache: false
      - if: matrix.zig
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2.90.3
        with:
          tool: cargo-zigbuild
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter caliper-docgen-napi
      - name: Build napi addon
        if: "!matrix.zig"
        working-directory: packages/napi
        env:
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
        run: pnpm napi build --platform --release --target "$TARGET" --manifest-path ../../crates/binding/Cargo.toml --output-dir .
      # napi-rs reads a `.<version>` suffix on `--target` as part of the ABI and
      # names the file `...linux-x64-gnu.2.28.node`, so the glibc floor is set by
      # cargo-zigbuild directly and the library is placed at napi's own name.
      - name: Build napi addon (glibc floor)
        if: matrix.zig
        env:
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform }}
          GLIBC: ${{ matrix.glibc }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo zigbuild --release --locked -p caliper-docgen-napi --target "${TARGET}.${GLIBC}"
          cp "target/${TARGET}/release/libcaliper_docgen_napi.so" "packages/napi/caliper_docgen_napi.${PLATFORM}.node"
      - name: Build CLI binary
        env:
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          ZIG: ${{ matrix.zig }}
          GLIBC: ${{ matrix.glibc }}
        run: cargo "${ZIG:+zig}build" --release --locked -p caliper-docgen --target "${TARGET}${GLIBC:+.$GLIBC}"

          TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform }}
          GLIBC: ${{ matrix.glibc }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

name: Release & Publish

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  # Finishes a release that stopped, and refreshes the release PR, without waiting for a push.
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 5 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_source_sha:
        description: 'Merged Callisto release-PR commit to recover; leave empty for the oldest unfinished release or the triggering commit.'
        required: false
        type: string

# Registry credentials exist only inside `execute`.
permissions: {}

# Per-commit group: a shared group would drop a queued release merge.
concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  # Keep in lockstep with .prototools.
  RUST_VERSION: "1.99.1"
  # `callisto release pending` reads the committed decision of each of the 10 newest release commits,
  # and fails with E166 on older ones whose decision no longer decodes. Count this release and newer.
  RELEASE_PENDING_FROM: 2daef9276b234fcc04d8994d91210eeccd88d7e8

jobs:
  release-candidate:
    name: Identify a merged Callisto release PR
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    timeout-minutes: 10
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      is_release_pr: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.is_release_pr }}
      release_source_sha: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@aebeedcdaa1dce8f0d9ad1836844ab6be68daf1f # callisto@0.20.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.20.0
          verification: require
      - id: candidate
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT: ${{ inputs.release_source_sha }}
          TRIGGERING_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          release_source_sha="$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT"
          selected_pending=false
          if [[ -z "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
            # Oldest unfinished release first: a failed release is finished before a newer one starts.
            pending_json=$(callisto --format json release pending --from "$RELEASE_PENDING_FROM")
            # A renamed or missing `pending` key would read as "nothing unfinished" and skip a stuck release.
            jq -e '(.pending | type) == "array"' <<<"$pending_json" > /dev/null \
              || { echo "::error::'release pending' output has no .pending array"; exit 1; }
            release_source_sha=$(jq -r '.pending[0].source // empty' <<<"$pending_json")
            if [[ -n "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
              selected_pending=true
            elif [[ "$EVENT_NAME" == push ]]; then
              release_source_sha="$TRIGGERING_SHA"
            else
              # A scheduled run with nothing unfinished only refreshes the release PR.
              echo 'is_release_pr=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          if [[ ! "$release_source_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters"
            exit 1
          fi
          resolved_sha=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.sha')
          if [[ "$resolved_sha" != "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha does not resolve to that exact commit"
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$release_source_sha" "$TRIGGERING_SHA"; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha is not on main's history"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Scheduling hint only; `callisto release plan` is the authority. A trusted release commit is
          # the merge of the managed PR and a GitHub-verified signed commit, never a direct push.
          prs=$(gh api --paginate "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}/pulls" | jq -s --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --arg sha "$release_source_sha" '[.[][] | select(.merged_at != null and .merge_commit_sha == $sha and .base.ref == "main" and .head.repo.full_name == $repo and (.head.ref == "callisto/version-packages" or (.head.ref | test("^callisto/version-packages--[0-9a-f]{40}$")))) | .number]')
          verified=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.commit.verification.verified')
          if [[ "$(jq 'length' <<< "$prs")" == 1 && "$verified" == true ]]; then
            {
              echo 'is_release_pr=true'
              echo "release_source_sha=$release_source_sha"
            } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [[ "$selected_pending" == true || -n "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT" || "$(jq 'length' <<< "$prs")" != 0 ]]; then
            echo "::error::release source is not one verified merged managed PR"
            exit 1

      actions: write
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

          release_branch: callisto/version-packages

      # per head commit: this workflow also runs daily and on every push to main.
      - name: Run CI on the release PR's head commit
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

          set -euo pipefail
          pr=$(gh pr list --state open --base main --json headRefName,headRefOid,headRepositoryOwner \
            --jq '[.[] | select((.headRefName | startswith("callisto/version-packages")) and .headRepositoryOwner.login == "'"${GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER}"'")] | first // empty')

    name: Derive release intent from the merged release commit
    needs: release-candidate
    if: needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 20

    env:
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      has_artifacts: ${{ steps.slots.outputs.has_artifacts }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # A detached checkout of the release commit: a branch checkout stops callisto with E170.
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@aebeedcdaa1dce8f0d9ad1836844ab6be68daf1f # callisto@0.20.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.20.0
          verification: require
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      # The orchestration revision is this run's own SHA: the build job's attestations are stamped with it.
      - name: Derive and hash intent
        env:
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          handoff_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          mkdir -p "$handoff_dir"
          callisto release plan \
            --source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" \
            --orchestration-revision "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --artifact-repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --from-release-commit "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" \
            --decision "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source/.callisto/release-decision.json" \
            --out "$handoff_dir/release-intent.json"

          (cd "$handoff_dir" && shasum -a 256 release-intent.json > release-intent.json.sha256)

          jq -e 'has("artifactSlots") and (.artifactSlots | type) == "array"' "$intent" > /dev/null \
            || { echo "::error::release intent has no .artifactSlots array"; exit 1; }
          has_artifacts=$(jq '.artifactSlots | length > 0' "$intent")
          case "$has_artifacts" in
            true|false) ;;
            *) echo "::error::artifact slot probe returned '$has_artifacts'"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          echo "has_artifacts=$has_artifacts" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
          if-no-files-found: error
          # Long enough to re-run `execute` after a multi-day diagnosis.
          retention-days: 7

  build:
    name: Build ${{ matrix.platform }}
    needs: [release-candidate, plan]
    timeout-minutes: 45
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.host }}
    permissions:

          - { host: macos-latest, target: aarch64-apple-darwin, platform: darwin-arm64, bin: caliper-docgen, asset: caliper-docgen-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz }
          - { host: macos-latest, target: x86_64-apple-darwin, platform: darwin-x64, bin: caliper-docgen, asset: caliper-docgen-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz }
          - { host: ubuntu-latest, target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, platform: linux-x64-gnu, bin: caliper-docgen, asset: caliper-docgen-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz, zig: true, glibc: '2.28' }
          - { host: ubuntu-latest, target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, platform: linux-arm64-gnu, bin: caliper-docgen, asset: caliper-docgen-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz, zig: true, glibc: '2.28' }
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      # No caches in release builds.
      - uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095 # v0.6.4
        with:
          auto-install: true
          cache: false
      - run: |
          rustup toolchain install "$RUST_VERSION" --profile minimal --target "$TARGET" --no-self-update
          rustup default "$RUST_VERSION"
        env:
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
      - if: matrix.zig
        uses: mlugg/setup-zig@d1434d08867e3ee9daa34448df10607b98908d29 # v2.2.1
        with:
          version: 0.14.1
          use-cache: false
      - if: matrix.zig
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2.90.3
        with:
          tool: cargo-zigbuild
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter caliper-docgen-napi
      - name: Build napi addon
        if: "!matrix.zig"
        working-directory: packages/napi
        env:
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
        run: pnpm napi build --platform --release --target "$TARGET" --manifest-path ../../crates/binding/Cargo.toml --output-dir .
      # napi-rs reads a `.<version>` suffix on `--target` as part of the ABI and
      # names the file `...linux-x64-gnu.2.28.node`, so the glibc floor is set by
      # cargo-zigbuild directly and the library is placed at napi's own name.
      - name: Build napi addon (glibc floor)
        if: matrix.zig
        env:
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform }}
          GLIBC: ${{ matrix.glibc }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo zigbuild --release --locked -p caliper-docgen-napi --target "${TARGET}.${GLIBC}"
          cp "target/${TARGET}/release/libcaliper_docgen_napi.so" "packages/napi/caliper_docgen_napi.${PLATFORM}.node"
      - name: Build CLI binary
        env:
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          ZIG: ${{ matrix.zig }}
          GLIBC: ${{ matrix.glibc }}
        run: cargo "${ZIG:+zig}build" --release --locked -p caliper-docgen --target "${TARGET}${GLIBC:+.$GLIBC}"
      # Fail the job if a Linux binary imports a GLIBC_ symbol newer than the floor.
      - name: Check the glibc floor
        if: matrix.glibc
        env:
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform }}
          GLIBC: ${{ matrix.glibc }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for f in "packages/napi/caliper_docgen_napi.${PLATFORM}.node" "target/${TARGET}/release/caliper-docgen"; do
            newest=$(objdump -T "$f" | grep -o 'GLIBC_[0-9.]*' | sort -uV | tail -n 1)
            echo "$f: newest imported symbol version ${newest:-none}"
            if [ -n "$newest" ] && [ "$(printf '%s\n' "${newest#GLIBC_}" "$GLIBC" | sort -V | tail -n 1)" != "$GLIBC" ]; then
              echo "::error::$f needs $newest, above the glibc $GLIBC floor"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: napi-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: packages/napi/caliper_docgen_napi.${{ matrix.platform }}.node
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: cli-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/${{ matrix.bin }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
      # Relative paths throughout.
      - name: Archive the CLI release asset
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
        env:
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          BIN: ${{ matrix.bin }}
          ASSET: ${{ matrix.asset }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p release-assets
          tar -C "target/${TARGET}/release" -czf "release-assets/${ASSET}" "$BIN"
      - name: Attest the exact asset bytes
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: release-assets/${{ matrix.asset }}
      - name: Upload the release asset
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-asset-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: release-assets/${{ matrix.asset }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  assemble:
    name: Assemble the attested release assets
    needs: [release-candidate, plan, build]
    if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@aebeedcdaa1dce8f0d9ad1836844ab6be68daf1f # callisto@0.20.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.20.0
          verification: require
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      # Every matrix target's asset, so a target added to the matrix cannot be built and then left out of the manifest.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: release-asset-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
      - name: Create the exact artifact manifest
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          (cd "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
          callisto release artifact-manifest \
            --intent "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent/release-intent.json" \
            --artifact-dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts" \
            --out "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts/manifest.json"
      # One artifact holding both directories keeps the intent and the manifest from different runs from being mixed.
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-build
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
            ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  execute:
    name: Execute approved release
    needs: [release-candidate, plan, build, assemble]
    # A release without the product package has no assets, so `assemble` is skipped by design;
    # a failed or cancelled `build` or `assemble` must still block. `!cancelled()`, not `always()`:
    # cancelling the run must stop the one irreversible job.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.plan.result == 'success' && needs.build.result == 'success' &&
      (needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'false' || needs.assemble.result == 'success')
    timeout-minutes: 60
    concurrency:
      group: release-execute
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Merging the release PR is the approval; no environment gate.
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      # `gh attestation verify` of the release assets.
      attestations: read
    env:
      NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE: "true"
      # Callisto parses `cargo info` stdout; forced color wraps its `version:` label in escapes (E176).
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # A detached checkout of the release commit: a branch checkout stops callisto with E170.
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@aebeedcdaa1dce8f0d9ad1836844ab6be68daf1f # callisto@0.20.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.20.0
          verification: require
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          # Tag dispatch pushes from here.
          persist-credentials: true
      # Outside release-source: callisto rejects non-ignored untracked files there.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      # Outside the checkout too: execute needs a clean release-source worktree.
      - if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-build
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-build
      - name: Verify same-run handoff before credentials
        env:
          HAS_ARTIFACTS: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
          (cd "$intent_dir" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
          if [[ "$HAS_ARTIFACTS" == true ]]; then
            cmp "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" "$build_dir/release-intent/release-intent.json"
          fi
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: napi-*
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-artifacts
          merge-multiple: true
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: cli-*
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/cli-artifacts
      - uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095 # v0.6.4
        with:
          auto-install: true
          cache: false
      - name: Install deps and place platform binaries
        working-directory: release-source
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
          (cd packages/napi && pnpm napi artifacts --output-dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}/napi-artifacts")
          for dir in "${RUNNER_TEMP}"/cli-artifacts/cli-*; do
            platform="${dir##*/cli-}"
            dest="packages/cli/npm/${platform}"
            [[ -d "$dest" ]] || { echo "::error::no package dir for $platform"; exit 1; }
            mv "$dir"/* "$dest/"
            chmod +x "$dest"/caliper-docgen*
          done
          for dir in packages/napi/npm/* packages/cli/npm/*; do
            files=$(jq -r '.files[]' "$dir/package.json")
            for f in $files; do
              [[ -f "$dir/$f" ]] || { echo "::error::missing $dir/$f"; exit 1; }
            done
          done
      - name: Require registry credentials
        env:
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          missing=0
          for name in NPM_TOKEN CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN; do
            if [[ -z "${!name}" ]]; then
              echo "::error::secret $name is empty; set it before the release can publish"
              missing=1
            fi
          done
          exit "$missing"
      # npm and pnpm both read the user-level .npmrc.
      - name: Authenticate with the npm registry
        env:
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
        run: npm config set //registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken "$NPM_TOKEN"
      - name: Execute verified release
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
          receipt_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-release-receipt/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          mkdir -p "$receipt_dir"
          args=(
            --source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source"
            --intent "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent/release-intent.json"
            --receipt "$receipt_dir/release-receipt.json"
            --orchestration-revision "$GITHUB_SHA"
          )
          if [[ -f "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json" ]]; then
            args+=(
              --artifact-manifest "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json"
              --artifact-dir "$build_dir/release-artifacts"
            )
          fi
          callisto release execute "${args[@]}"
      - name: Summarize receipt
        if: always()
        run: |
          receipt="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-release-receipt/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}/release-receipt.json"
          if [[ -f "$receipt" ]]; then
            {
              echo '### Release receipt'
              echo '```json'
              cat "$receipt"
              echo '```'
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
      - name: Upload receipt
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          # Per attempt: a re-run keeps each attempt's receipt instead of replacing the last.
          name: release-receipt-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/callisto-release-receipt/${{ github.run_id }}
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

  drain:
    name: Start the next unfinished release
    needs: [execute, release-candidate]
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.execute.result == 'success' &&
      needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: write
      contents: read
    outputs:
      has_pending: ${{ steps.pending.outputs.has_p

_2026-11-21 · [compare](https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto/compare/callisto@0.21.1...callisto@0.22.0)_

### Minor Changes

- **Shorter release configuration.** List your build targets once and let Callisto name each asset, and drop `forge-repository`.

  - **How to adopt:** replace repeated `[[release.artifact]]` blocks for the product with `targets = [...]` and `asset-name = "tool-{target}.tar.gz"` under `[release]`. Keep `[[release.artifact]]` for another package's artifact or an irregular name such as a Windows `.zip`.
  - `forge-repository` is optional: Callisto uses the `origin` GitHub repository, which every release already required it to equal.
  - `callisto init` now writes `targets` and one `asset-name` template, named after the single binary or after the package when it has several.
  - **Limits:** `{target}` is the only placeholder. A target named by both `targets` and a `[[release.artifact]]` of the product is E197.

  **Breaking:** `callisto init` no longer asks for or accepts `--forge-repository`.

  **Action:** drop `--forge-repository` from scripted `init` calls.
- **Generated release workflows publish only what a credential-free job built.** Package scripts, build backends and crate builds no longer run in the job that holds your registry tokens.

  - The publish job uploads exactly the Python files and npm tarballs that a job without credentials built and sealed.
  - Crates publish with `cargo publish --no-verify` after a credential-free job compiled every crate of the release, including a Cargo workspace under a directory such as `native/` with no root manifest.
  - The simple workflow now has `version-pr`, `package` and `execute` jobs.
  - The build-matrix workflow gains `attest`, `package-cargo` and `pack-npm` jobs.
  - Only `execute` holds secrets, and only the attestation job holds an OIDC token without checking out your code.
  - npm packages are packed by their workspace's own package manager, so `workspace:` and `catalog:` ranges are rewritten in the published tarball.
  - A local `callisto release` still verifies crates and packs in place, with registry credentials withheld from the build.

  **Breaking:** npm publishes ran the `prepublishOnly`, `publish` and `postpublish` hooks. They now run `npm publish <tarball> --ignore-scripts`, so those hooks no longer run, and `prepack` and `prepare` run in the pack job, which has no registry credentials. Move work that must run at publish time into `prepack` or a step of your own after `execute`.

  **Breaking:** the simple workflow published whenever an untagged version was merged. It now publishes only when a push adds or changes the release decision file. Release through a push that adds or changes that file.

  **Breaking:** an npm or PyPI publish that is not sealed in the artifact manifest used to proceed. It now fails with E306 before anything is published. Regenerate the workflow so the credential-free job seals it.

  **Breaking:** `npm publish <tarball>` does not read a registry set in `.yarnrc.yml` or `bunfig.toml`, and Yarn and Bun token settings are not used either. A yarn workspace whose `.yarnrc.yml` sets `npmPublishRegistry` or `npmRegistryServer` (at the top level or under `npmScopes`), or a bun workspace whose `bunfig.toml` sets a registry, now fails with E168 before anything is published. Move the registry to `publishConfig.registry` in your package's `package.json`, or to `.npmrc`, and keep the publish token in `NPM_TOKEN`.

  **Action:** delete `.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml`, regenerate it with `callisto init --workflow`, and close any stray release PR it opened. Yarn and Bun users: move the registry to `publishConfig.registry` or `.npmrc`. Move work from `prepublishOnly`, `publish` or `postpublish` into `prepack` or a step after `execute`.
- **Changesets 3.x prerelease cycles work.** A repository mid-cycle with the `pre.json` that `@changesets/cli` 3.x writes (only `mode` and `tag`) now versions, reruns and exits instead of failing with E114.

  - Applied changesets move to `.changeset/pre/`, as Changesets v3 does, and are released together at `pre exit`.
  - `pre.json` is written back in the shape it was read, v2 or v3, and keeps keys Callisto does not know. A cycle Callisto starts with `pre enter` still writes v2.
  - The E114, E115 and E243 help no longer suggests deleting `pre.json` and re-entering, which would drop a cycle's archived notes.
- **`status --since <ref>` catches a pull request that forgot its changeset.** Run `callisto status --check --since origin/main` in CI to fail when a package changed on the branch and no changeset names it.

  - A package whose bump is inferred from commits passes without one.
  - A change that needs no release takes a changeset with severity `none`.
- **Dry-run refusals share one error code, and a no-op flag is gone.** `--dry-run` on a command that cannot preview now always fails with `E309`, naming the command.

  - Why it matters: one code to match instead of five, and fewer codes to keep stable.
  - How to adopt it: match `E309` where you matched `E216`, `E217`, `E218` or `E282`.
  - Limits: the message and fix text now name the command, for example `release plan refuses --dry-run`.

  **Breaking:** `callisto version --refresh-lockfiles` is removed. It did nothing, since lockfiles refresh by default. Remove the flag from scripts; use `--no-refresh-lockfiles` to skip the refresh.

  **Breaking:** `E216`, `E217`, `E218` and `E282` are retired and no longer emitted. `release artifact-manifest`, `release plan`, `release execute` and `release-pr commit-plan` with `--dry-run` now fail with `E309`, as `release build-python`, `release pack-npm` and `release package-cargo` already did.

  **Action:** update scripts that match `E216`, `E217`, `E218` or `E282` to match `E309`, and drop `--refresh-lockfiles` from `version` calls.
- **Release PRs open for releases inferred from commits.** A package with `release-trigger = "auto"` now gets a release PR from its commits alone; it no longer needs a changeset to be released.

  - `release-pr decide` opens a PR whenever `callisto version` would version a package, after groups and dependents.
  - A changeset that cannot be parsed now fails `release-pr decide` with the error `version` reports, instead of a green run that releases nothing.
  - `status` no longer warns `inferred-release-without-changeset`; that diagnostic code is gone.

  **Scripting:** `version --emit-decision` writes decision schema 3, which adds `consumedChangesets`. Release verification (E165) checks that the release commit deletes exactly those changesets. Schema 1 and 2 decisions still read.
- **`callisto init` migrates a Changesets config.**
  Switch an `@changesets/cli` 2.x or 3.x repository to Callisto without rewriting its groups or release branch by hand.

  - **Why it matters:** `init` reads `.changeset/config.json` and reports every setting it did not carry over, so none goes silently inert.
  - **How to adopt:** run `callisto init` in the repository.
    - Translated:
      - `fixed` becomes `[[fixed-group]]` entries, with globs expanded to the npm packages that exist now.
      - `baseBranch` becomes the branch filter of the generated release workflow.
    - Reported, not translated:
      - `linked`, `ignore` and `updateInternalDependencies`.
      - Any other non-empty key, such as `changelog` or `commit`.
  - **Limits:**
    - Add packages created after `init` to the fixed groups by hand.
    - A fixed group that uses negation (`!`), braces, character classes or extglobs is not written: the warning gives the block to paste once you have checked its members.
    - `linked` is not translated: a Callisto linked group bumps every member on each release, while Changesets bumps only members with changesets.

  **Action:** if `access` is `restricted` or absent and a scoped npm package has no `publishConfig.access`, `init` refuses (E342) unless you pass `--yes`, because Callisto publishes such packages as public. Set `publishConfig.access` in each listed package.json, or pass `--yes`.
- **Peer dependents now get a patch, not a major.** An out-of-range peer-dependency bump releases the dependent with `cascade.bump-severity` (patch by default), matching Changesets v3.

  **Breaking:** `cascade.peer-escalation` now defaults to `false`. Before, an out-of-range peer bump from a minor or major source released the dependent as a major. Now it gets `bump-severity`. To keep the old behavior, set `peer-escalation = true` under `[cascade]`, or add an explicit major changeset for the dependent.
- **Release pull requests run prerelease cycles.** After `callisto pre enter <tag>`, the release workflow keeps a release PR open: each new changeset, or new commit to a `release-trigger = "auto"` package, opens or updates it for the next prerelease, and after `callisto pre exit` it releases the stable versions.

  - `release-pr decide` no longer refuses pre mode, so E318 is retired.
  - A cycle with nothing new since its last prerelease needs no release PR.
  - Works with both Changesets v2 and v3 `pre.json` state.
- **Each registry has one name, used in both `[registries]` and `publish-to`.** You configure crates.io as `[registries.crates-io]`, the same name you publish to, and a mistyped registry kind is caught when the config loads instead of during a release.

  - **How to adopt:** `crates-io`, `npm` and `pypi` always exist. Add `[registries.crates-io]`, `[registries.npm]` or `[registries.pypi]` only to change a setting such as `confirm-timeout`; `kind` can be left out.
  - **Limits:** a custom registry with `kind = "npm"` or `kind = "pypi"` cannot be named in `publish-to` yet.
  - **Limits:** a custom npm registry's `url` only approves a package's `publishConfig.registry`.

  **Breaking:** `[registries.cratesIo]` used to configure crates.io. It now fails when the config loads with E325, and the message names the new spelling. Rename it to `[registries.crates-io]`.

  **Breaking:** `crates-io`, `npm` or `pypi` given another `kind` (for example `[registries.npm] kind = "cargo"`) used to load and then fail during a release. It now fails when the config loads with E334. Remove the `kind`, or give a custom registry another name.

  **Breaking:** A registry named `none` or `github-release`, or with characters other than letters, digits, `-` and `_`, used to load. It now fails with E325. Rename the registry.

  **Breaking:** `publish-to = ["nuget"]` used to load and then fail during a release. It now fails when the config loads with E330. Remove `nuget` from `publish-to`.

  **Breaking:** A release plan saved by an earlier version used to be read. It is now refused with E215. Run `callisto release plan` again.

  **Action:** Rename `[registries.cratesIo]` to `[registries.crates-io]` and remove `nuget` from `publish-to` before upgrading.
- **Publish to a private Cargo registry.** Name a `kind = "cargo"` registry in `publish-to` and Callisto publishes and checks that crate there instead of on crates.io.

  - **Why it matters:** crates for an internal registry can now be released with the same flow as every other package.
  - **How to adopt:**
    - Declare `[registries.<name>]` with `kind = "cargo"`.
    - Define its URL in `.cargo/config.toml`.
    - Set `publish-to = ["<name>"]` on the package.
    - Give the release job `CARGO_REGISTRIES_<NAME>_TOKEN` (the name upper-cased, `-` as `_`).
    - Callisto then runs `cargo publish --registry <name>` and `cargo info --registry <name>`.
  - **Limits:** a `url` on a Cargo registry is still rejected, because Cargo takes the URL from `.cargo/config.toml`. A name that is not a `kind = "cargo"` registry fails with E330.
- **`[[package-set]]` is folded into `[[package]]`.** One table now takes an exact name or a glob, and every field, `pre-major-inference` included, applies the same either way.

  - Why it matters: `pre-major-inference` on a `[[package-set]]` was ignored; on a glob `[[package]]` it now takes effect.
  - How to adopt it: rename each `[[package-set]]` to `[[package]]`; its `match` already holds a glob. A `match` with any of `*?[]{}` is a glob.
  - Limits:
    - An exact rule wins over any glob, then the first glob in declaration order. Fields are not merged across rules.
    - A renamed `match` with no glob character is now exact. It outranks globs, and for a private npm workspace root it makes that root a package.
    - `previous-tag-templates` names one package's old tags, so a glob that sets it is E338.

  **Breaking:** `[[package-set]]` is no longer a key. A `callisto.toml` that still has one fails with E325 and a message telling you to rename it.

  **Breaking:** the `package-set-matched-nothing` diagnostic code is gone. A glob that matches no package now reports `package-rule-matched-nothing`, the code exact rules already used.

  **Action:** rename `[[package-set]]` to `[[package]]` in `callisto.toml`, and match `package-rule-matched-nothing` in anything that read `package-set-matched-nothing` from `--json` output.

### Patch Changes

- **Retrying `version` finishes when its emitted decision is inside the workspace.** A run that wrote `--emit-decision` or `--emit-preview` into `.changeset` and was then interrupted no longer refuses its own retry with `E340`.

  - A hand edit to that file after the interruption is still refused.
- **Package directories with unusual names release correctly.** A package directory named with `*`, `?` or leading spaces is now read as exactly that directory.

  - Commit inference and the version commit no longer pick up a sibling such as `packages/odd-other` for a package in `packages/odd*`.
  - A commit message containing the U+001E control character no longer stops inference with `E026`.
  - Resuming an interrupted `version` run in a workspace directory with leading or trailing spaces resumes that workspace, not a similarly named sibling.
- **Large pnpm workspaces load much faster.** Relative `workspace:../path` dependencies are now resolved through one directory index instead of a scan per dependency.

  - At 800 packages with relative `workspace:` paths, `status` drops from about 4.9 s to 0.6 s, `version --dry-run` from 7.6 s to 0.8 s and `release --dry-run` from 6.3 s to 0.9 s.
  - No configuration change is needed. Dependency edges and warnings are unchanged.
- **`release-pr` JSON arguments report where a failure came from.** A relative `--decision` or `--snapshot` file is now read relative to `--cwd`, and a bad file no longer looks like a usage mistake.

  - Malformed inline or stdin JSON is still `E281`, exit 2, naming the flag.
  - A malformed file is `E238`, exit 1, naming the file; an unreadable file is `E213`.
  - `compose-pr-body --preview` follows the same rule: a malformed preview file is `E238`, exit 1, instead of `E281`.

  **Scripting:** treat exit 1 from a file argument as a data problem, not a bad invocation.
- **Fixed groups no longer leak provisional versions into dependency ranges.** When a fixed group aligned its members to a lower version than a member's own bump, a dependent's requirement could be rewritten to the provisional version, widening a range, or rejected (E319) for a version that was never released.

  - Rewrites and E319 now follow the group's final aligned versions, for Cargo, npm and Python.
  - If a run aborted with E319 naming a version your fixed group never released, re-run it.
- **Dual-published packages no longer hit a false cycle error.** A release of packages published to both Cargo and npm now plans when their dependencies point opposite ways in the two ecosystems.

  - Why it matters: crate `a` depending on crate `b`, with npm `b` depending on npm `a`, failed with `E104` although each registry orders cleanly.
  - Limits: a runtime, build or optional cycle among the published crates and packages, including through a dependency published only to the other registry, still fails with `E104`.
- **Tokenless PyPI publishing works when `PYPI_TOKEN` is empty.** An empty PyPI credential is no longer handed to `twine`, so it falls back to trusted publishing (OIDC) instead of failing on empty credentials.

  - Why it matters: workflows that map `PYPI_TOKEN` from an unset or blank secret now publish through trusted publishing.
  - How to adopt: configure a trusted publisher on PyPI and leave `PYPI_TOKEN` unset or empty.
- **Generated release workflows carry any valid branch name.** `callisto init` no longer truncates a default branch such as `release/next` to `next`, and no longer breaks the workflow YAML for branch names containing `,`, `#`, `]` or similar.

  - **Why it matters:** the push trigger and the action `branch` input now name the real default branch, so version PRs target the right base.
